name: Garnier
source:
The cool and collected prime minister of Mersin.

He rose to prominence from an ordinary background and won himself a role in national politics through his competence. 

Unmarried but very fond of women, he often brings them into his chambers. He gets along poorly with the princess, though, and the two are frequently at odds.
